prototype_diagnostic.receipt_format: Original valid JSON retained unchanged; no numeric normalization.

notes: Software stall/exit injection while CUDA sessions were live; not every hardware/driver fault.
100 virtual streams cycle 30 frozen public recordings; no new video or physical-camera qualification.
Polled deadlines include IPC/collection after dispatch; sampled child age excludes result transport.
Failure accounting is explicit; unreceived results can be failed even if computed, with no automatic sample retry.
A ten-minute bounded repeat is not 24-hour recording, field accuracy or sustained operating acceptance.
